items.name: Default
items.summary: Labeled grip for application-defined dragging and reordering. Use when an item needs a dedicated move control.

items.name: Pressed
items.summary: Pressed grip for an item selected for movement. Use to show the handle state while the application manages reordering.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disabled grip for an item that cannot move. Use to keep the control visible while movement is unavailable.
